title: Shooter Component
description: Ranged weapon component for projectile-based attacks.
content:
Shooter Component

Ranged weapon component for projectile-based attacks, managing fire rate, spread, and burst fire.

Component Weapon

Schema

JSON
"shooterComponent": {
  "projectileVelocity": 0.0,
  "projectileIDs": [...],
  "defaultProjectileID": "...",
  "projectilesPerShot": 1,
  "playerFriendly": true,
  "addedDamage": 0.0,
  "gunPointX": 0.0,
  "gunPointY": 0.0
}

Description

The ShooterComponent is a ranged weapon component that handles projectile-based attacks. It manages projectile spawning, velocity, multi-projectile shots, and muzzle positioning. The component supports multiple projectile types via projectileIDs and provides damage bonuses on top of the base projectile damage.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
projectileVelocityfloatOverride velocity for spawned projectiles.
projectileIDsstring[]Array of available projectile entity IDs this shooter can fire.
defaultProjectileIDstringThe default projectile entity ID used when no specific one is selected.
projectilesPerShotintNumber of projectiles fired per shot (e.g. shotgun spread).
playerFriendlyboolIf true, projectiles will not damage the player.
addedDamagefloatBonus damage added on top of the projectile's base damage.
gunPointXfloatX offset of the projectile spawn point relative to the entity.
gunPointYfloatY offset of the projectile spawn point relative to the entity.

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "shooterComponent": {
      "projectileVelocity": 200.0,
      "projectileIDs": ["plasma_bolt", "plasma_bolt_charged"],
      "defaultProjectileID": "plasma_bolt",
      "projectilesPerShot": 1,
      "playerFriendly": true,
      "addedDamage": 5.0,
      "gunPointX": 8.0,
      "gunPointY": -2.0
    }
  }
}
